messages:
auditor_nina: Hi team — auditors need an evidence bundle tying RBAC edits (k8s RoleBinding / ClusterRoleBinding + IAM policy commits) to KMS activity (Decrypt, GenerateDataKey, ReEncrypt) for window 2025-11-20T00:00Z → 2025-11-23T00:00Z. Require signed manifest + per-file SHA256, short control map to SOC2/ISO, and a tiny sanitized example row.

zara: We can produce. Clarify: include admin console and terraform apply logs? EKM optional.

auditor_nina: Yes to admin console + terraform. Start with CMKs. Consolidated bundle across prod regions is fine.

lee: Plan: export CloudTrail (eventName in Decrypt, GenerateDataKey, ReEncrypt, CreateGrant), k8s audit for RoleBinding/ClusterRoleBinding changes, admin_ui audit, terraform_runs, and incident index. Correlate by time window (±3–4m), token issuer (OIDC sub/iss), and source meta (IP/userAgent).

zara: Splunk queries I'll run (prod indexes):
```spl
index=cloudtrail (eventName=Decrypt OR eventName=GenerateDataKey OR eventName=ReEncrypt OR eventName=CreateGrant)
| eval ts=_time
| table ts, eventName, userIdentity.arn, requestParameters.keyId, requestParameters.keyAlias, sourceIPAddress, userAgent
| sort ts
```
```spl
index=k8s_audit (objectRef.resource=rolebindings OR objectRef.resource=clusterrolebindings)
| table _time, user.username, verb, objectRef.resource, objectRef.name, requestObject
```

lee: Correlation CSV columns: rb_time, rb_actor, rb_object, rb_action, kms_time, kms_actor, key_id, key_alias, correlation_score, incident_id, manifest_sig_ref. Scoring rules doc will show weights (time=40, issuer=30, ip/ua=20, infra_ref=10).

oncall-bot: INCIDENT 2025-11-21T02:15Z - autoscaler rollback detected. ID: INC-20251121-2

auditor_nina: Please annotate rows related to INC-20251121-2 and flag any ephemeral keys (alias/ephemeral/*). Also include retention notes (CloudTrail 180d, k8s_audit 90d, admin_ui 365d).

zara: Staging (unsigned) bundle: s3://redwood-compliance/temp/1955555555-evidence-bundle.zip. Contents: cloudtrail.csv, k8s_audit.csv, admin_ui.csv, terraform_runs.csv, correlation.csv, scoring_rules.md, control_map.md, README.md, manifest.json. We'll compute per-file SHA256 and sign manifest.json with KMS key alias/audit-sign, producing manifest.json.sig, then move to s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/1955555555/.

lee: Example signing flow we'll run: 
```bash
sha256sum cloudtrail.csv k8s_audit.csv admin_ui.csv terraform_runs.csv > manifest.json
aws kms sign --key-id alias/audit-sign --message fileb://manifest.json --signature fileb://manifest.json.sig
aws s3 cp ./1955555555-evidence-bundle.zip s3://redwood-compliance/temp/
aws s3 mv s3://redwood-compliance/temp/1955555555-evidence-bundle.zip s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/1955555555-evidence-bundle.zip
```

zara: Sample sanitized row (emails hashed, ids truncated):
"rbac_1740001234 | 8f2d... (email hash) | RoleBinding:prod-autoscaler | patch | kms_1740001250 | svc-account-autoscaler | key/aa11-zzzz | alias/ephemeral/autoscale | 0.91 | INC-20251121-2 | s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/1955555555/manifest.json.sig"

auditor_nina: ETA for signed bundle? Also please include a short mapping to SOC2 CC6/CC7 and ISO A.9/A.12 in control_map.md.

zara: ETA ~5 hours. We'll DM presigned link when done and include redaction notes. If we need EKM logs after review I'll add ekm_audit. Thanks. :thumbsup:
